_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6: Crawdaddy, Teramute, Bombarder ($9088-$9319). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): first frame?
regions.description: Type bit 7 set (initialised) goes to `$90B9`. Table stats: flags `$5A` (Eraser-immune, the big burst), hit points 9 x 16 = 144, attack 12, art block `$49`, dies as type 7.

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): art and hit points
regions.description: `JSR $C0A8` (the art wait), `JSR $C165` (hit points x 16).

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): set-up
regions.description: x `$80`, y `$60`, the y target `$0668` := `$30`, attribute 0, `$07A0` := 4, metasprite `$2A` (the body), the arrival timer `$0788` := `$78`, the phase counters cleared.

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): the arrival
regions.description: `JSR $C009`: 120 frames of flicker (drawn every second frame, no AI) while the timer runs.

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): y spring
regions.description: Acceleration 9 toward the y target `$30`: it climbs from y `$60` and settles about y 48.

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): x: home on the player
regions.description: **The x target `$0680` := the player's x (`$0530` of slot 0); the x spring (`$C09F`) with acceleration 4.**

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): move and draw
regions.description: `JSR $C08D`; carry (off the screen sideways) calls `$8E20` (x := the edge and the x speed negated: an edge bounce) and goes to the hit test.

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): the phase
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` with A = `$20`, Y = 8: the phase `$0638` steps every 8 frames through 0-7; **odd phases skip the shot** (`$9124`).

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): once a phase
regions.description: Only on the frame the fraction `$0650` is under `$20` (the first of the phase's eight).

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): a shot: aim
regions.description: `JSR $C0FF`: the direction to the player into `$15`; a free slot (`$C108`); `JSR $C105` makes a type-`$2C` child 56 px (`$38`) below the body.

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): a shot: its fields
regions.description: Heading `$0788` := the aim, speed class `$0698` := 5 (2.3 px a frame), art block `$07B8` := `$49`, score class `$07D0` := 5, tile offset `$07A0` := `$30`, metasprite `$19`, attribute `$80`. **The generic aimed shot `$2C` (`$9742`): its art block, picture, speed and score class all come from the spawner's fields.**

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): the claws
regions.description: Two pieces drawn by `$914A`: x - 10 (`$F6`) with the animation pattern `$9180[phase]` (`0 1 2 3 4 3 2 1`) and x + 10 with the pattern four phases later, so they alternate.

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): the hit test
regions.description: `JSR $C0C6` (an ordinary enemy's test) and `JMP $C0D8` (the boss rules).

regions.name: CRAWDADDY, type `$45` (corridor 2's boss; bank 6 `$9088`): draw a claw (`$914A`)
regions.description: A = the x offset: the piece at (x + A, y + `$20`) with the attribute `$9171[n]` (`40 40 00 00 00`: mirrored for the first two pictures) and the metasprite `$9176[n]` (`22 23 24 23 22`); skipped if it would leave the screen sideways.

regions.name: Crawdaddy's claw attributes
Crawdaddy's claw metasprites
Crawdaddy: five bytes no traced code reads
regions.description: `14 0C FC F4 EC`: LEAD (the plausible reading is a set of x offsets, but nothing indexes them).

regions.name: Crawdaddy's claw animation
regions.description: `00 01 02 03 04 03 02 01`: the pose by phase.

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): first frame?
regions.description: The type in Y; an initialised object (bit 7) goes to `$91D9`; Teramute (`$46`) takes `$91A1`. Table stats: flags `$5A`, dies as type 7; **`$46`: hit points 16 x 16 = 256, attack 16, art block `$44`; `$4C`: 12 x 16 = 192, attack 32; `$4D`: 15 x 16 = 240, attack 48; both Bombarders art block `$2A`.**

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): Bombarder: its parameters
regions.description: **`$07B8` := `$92CC[type]` = 1 (`$4C`) or 5 (`$4D`) - the KIND of homing bullet its ring uses - and the attribute := `$8FE6[type]` (palette 2 / 0).**

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): Bombarder: the body
regions.description: Y := `$6D` (the body metasprite).

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): Teramute: its parameters
regions.description: Attribute 1, metasprite `$88`.

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): the picture
regions.description: The attribute and the metasprite stored.

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): art and hit points
regions.description: `JSR $C0A8`, `JSR $C165` (hit points x 16).

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): appear at a random place
regions.description: `JSR $C0F0` (a random x, y 8), the attribute's mirror bit flipped, **y := (x AND `$7F`) + `$20`** (32-159).

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): start the cycle
regions.description: Timer `$0788` := `$78`, state `$07A0` := 0, `$0680` := 4, the phase cleared.

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): the state timer
regions.description: `DEC $0788`; when it goes negative: **the direction to the player into `$0668`, the state `$07A0` += 1 and the timer reloaded with `$78`.**

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): which state?
regions.description: 0 and 2 are the flicker states, 1 the attack, 3 hidden, over 3 starts again.

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): states 0 and 2: flicker
regions.description: A second decrement of the timer (so these last about 60 frames); the body is drawn on frames where the timer's bit 1 is set. State 3 just returns (hidden).

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): draw
regions.description: `JSR $C090` and the pieces (`$92BE`).

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): state 1: the attack
regions.description: Drawn; the phase counter (A = `$20`, Y = 9: a phase per 8 frames, 0-8).

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): which boss?
regions.description: The type with its bit 7 (`$C6` = Teramute) goes to the fan at `$9257`.

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): Bombarder: at phase 2
regions.description: Phase 2 starts the ring; any other phase goes to `$92B2`.

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): not yet
TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): Bombarder: the ring
regions.description: The phase `$0638` += 1 (so the ring is once) and the timer `$0788` := `$1E`; **16 type-`$27` bullets, one for every heading from the aim - 3 to the aim + 12 (all 16 directions), each of kind `$07B8`** (a slot for each; it stops if one is missing). RUN: 16 bullets in one frame (kind 1 for `$4C`, 5 for `$4D`).

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): Teramute: the fan
regions.description: Once a phase (fraction under `$20`): **the heading `$0680` := (`$92FD[phase]` = -4 ... +4) + the aim, AND 15**; the picture index from `$9306[heading AND 7]`; a type-`$2C` missile (`$C105`) 16 px lower: heading, speed class `$41` (1.9 px a frame), art block `$07B8` := 3, score class `$07D0` := 5, tile offset `$930E[i]`, metasprite `$9310[i]` (`$19` or `$37` by the direction), attribute `$81`. RUN: a missile every 8 frames (15 in the 121-frame attack), sweeping around the aim.

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): the common end
regions.description: `JSR $C0B1` (the hit box), the pieces (`$92BE`), `JSR $C0C9` and `JMP $C0D8` (the boss rules).

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): Teramute's head (`$92BE`)
regions.description: Type `$C6`: the head piece with the flip `$9312[heading / 4]` OR 1 and the metasprite `$9316[$9306[heading AND 7]]` (`$8A` or `$89`): **the head turns to face the heading.**

regions.name: TERAMUTE `$46` AND BOMBARDER `$4C` / `$4D` (bank 6 `$9188`; corridors 4, 13, 19): Bombarder's second half
regions.description: Any other type: metasprite `$6D` again 31 px lower and flipped vertically, and the hit box (`$0728`) lowered by `$20` to cover it.

regions.name: Teramute's fan offsets
regions.description: `FC FD FE FF 00 01 02 03 04`: the heading offset by phase 0-8.

regions.name: Picture index by heading AND 7
Missile tile offset and metasprite
regions.description: `00 04 | 19 37`: [tile offset x 2][metasprite x 2] read as `$930E,i` and `$9310,i`.

regions.name: Teramute's head flip by heading / 4
Head metasprites, then the Bombarder kinds
regions.description: `8A 89` (the head pictures) and `01 05` (the bullet kind `$92CC + type` reads for `$4C`, `$4D`: the base lies 76 bytes before).
